evidence.title: GitHub - Gsync/jobsync: Job application tracker and AI-powered job search assistant.

name: JobSync
summary: Self-hosted job search assistant: application tracker, AI resume review, job matching and automated job discovery.
description: A self-hosted web app for running a job search: track applications, contacts, companies, tasks and interview questions, get AI resume reviews and job match scores, and write cover letters in a docked chat. Deploys with Docker, includes an MCP server so agents can add jobs, scheduled discovery over Greenhouse, Lever and Ashby job boards, resume import/export as PDF or Word and backup as a zip. Runs on local Ollama models or cloud provider keys; data stays on your own server.
contains: self-hosted via Docker, web UI on port 3737
AI chat: resume review, job match, cover letter, add job from pasted posting
MCP server for Claude Desktop and other agents
automated discovery over Greenhouse, Lever (1,160+ companies) and Ashby (1,860+ companies)
resume import from PDF/Word and export to PDF
tracker for applications, tasks, contacts, company pages, question bank
local AI via Ollama or cloud provider keys
full backup and restore as one zip
